acquisition method: The system was run in data-dependent mode selecting the 10 most abundant ions for fractionation for higher energy collision-induced dissociation.
cleavage agent: Proteins were digested “on bead” first by lysyl endopeptidase (LysC, Wako chemicals) before being trypsinated (Trypsin, Promega) overnight.
enrichment method: The azido group is subsequently used to covalently link the nascent proteins to alkyne-bearing agarose beads by click chemistry (Dieterich et al,).
fractionation method: resuspended in no-salt buffer (0.5% formic acid and 15% acetonitrile) before being put on strong cation exchange (SCX) tips (Empore, 3M).
fragmentation method: The system was run in data-dependent mode selecting the 10 most abundant ions for fractionation for higher energy collision-induced dissociation.
instrument: An electrospray ion source (ThermoScientific) was used to ionize the peptides that were subsequently analysed using a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoScientific).
ionization type: An electrospray ion source (ThermoScientific) was used to ionize the peptides
labeling: stable isotope labelling by amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)
Parental SPRET/EiJ, C57BL/6J and the F1 fibroblasts were cultured in stable isotope labelling by amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) DMEM
